Imports lib/commerce/marketplace-entry.ts with a probe secret: a first view writes a stamp; a repeat view of the same product within the hour returns null (no Set-Cookie); a new product still writes and the stamp holds both; re-viewing the older product still reorders it to the front; a repeat view an hour on re-signs with a fresh iat, so the seven-day window still slides. append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1633). Owner ruling "Fix it" (2026-09-29 ~19:10Z): write only when missing or changed, attribution unchanged. stampMarketplaceView now returns null (the proxy writes no fq_mkt) when the held stamp is valid, the view leaves its product and Journey lists equal in value and order, and its iat is under an hour old (MARKETPLACE_ENTRY_REFRESH_MS). ATTRIBUTION KEPT (ADR-1419): same 20 products and 10 Journeys, newest first, a re-view still moves an older id to the front and writes, so the caps evict exactly as before; same seven-day max age, verifyStamp and checkout untouched. The one difference: a repeat view re-signs only once iat is an hour old, so the window lapses between 7 days less an hour and 7 days after the last discovery view (before: exactly 7 days). It can only end earlier, never later. Half-max-age refresh (the filing's suggestion) was rejected as a real window change, and LIVE-649's full-page-load refresh as missing in-app navigations; the stamp carries its own iat, so the age test covers every request type. No dependency on the LIVE-649 helper. TESTS: lib/commerce/marketplace-entry.test.ts and proxy-consent.test.ts (the real proxy: a repeat GET and a Server Action POST send no fq_mkt, a new product does). Each fails on the pre-change code.
